question: Select the synonym of **Summon.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Call**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Summon"** means to officially call upon someone to be present, especially as an authoritative command. (आमंत्रित करना / बुलाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher decided to summon all the students for an emergency meeting.
 
 
• **"Call"** refers to the act of asking or requesting someone to come, often using words or signals. (बुलाना)
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to call her friend to join her for lunch.
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of "Summon" is "Call".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Call**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Send** (भेजना): To cause something to go or be taken to a particular destination.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to send a parcel to his friend living in another city.
 
 
 
• **Disperse** (फैलाना): To distribute or spread something over a wide area.
 
 
• **Example:** The police had to disperse the crowd after the protest.
 
 
 
• **Drive** (चालित करना): To operate and control the direction and speed of a vehicle or to propel something forward.
 
 
• **Example:** She learned to drive a car last summer.

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
